candidates.why_new: Covers the same BINUH Q3 2026 report whose topline aggregate figures (44 PNH extrajudicial-execution cases vs 14 the prior quarter; roughly half of Q3 deaths occurring in security-force operations) already appear in the corpus via a different secondary source staged 25.11.
